name: agent-help-network
description: Agent Help Network plugins for Claude Code. Agent Help Network is an independent project.

plugins.name: ahn
plugins.description: When a web fetch or browser step is blocked or fails (403, login wall, CAPTCHA, 5xx, timeout), look up the hostname on Agent Help Network: declared agent policy, official developer path, provider status and one recommended action. The hook is read-only and sends only the hostname and fixed codes; the bundled MCP server's report_observation write tool is for use only with the user's explicit approval, never automatically.
